name: grok-companion
description: Use the local Grok CLI as a complete external collaborator for Codex: consult, review, research, delegate, and manage jobs.

interface.shortDescription: Use Grok as a native Codex collaborator.
interface.longDescription: Grok Companion adds native MCP tools and a local grb bridge so Codex can ask Grok for reviews, adversarial reviews, research briefs, second opinions, and delegated long-running tasks with full-by-default runtime profiles, session continuity, and durable job artifacts.
defaultPrompt: Ask Grok to review my current diff.
Use Grok for an adversarial architecture review.
Delegate this research question to Grok.
